title: Vacuum popcorn: code, data and manuscript
description: Code, data and literature notes for the letter "Vacuum popcorn: ultra-high-energy particles from collapsing false-vacuum pockets". A pocket of false vacuum that traps particles which are light inside it and heavy outside throws them out when it collapses. Every number in the letter is produced by a script in calc/; calc/run_all.sh reruns them, and each script's output is included as run. letter/ holds the manuscript source, its figures and a typeset preprint; data/ holds the published cosmic-ray events used, with the source of every row.
